title: The Capital Market Consequences of Tenure-Based Voting Rights: Evidence from the Florange Act
eligible_reason: Not eligible: single adoption date. The treatment is DVR (firm adopts double voting rights by default under the 2014 Florange Act) interacted with post_4 (fiscal years after 2014), with firm FE and year FE (areg ... c.DVR#c.post_4 ... i.year, absorb(firm_id)); all columns add time-varying firm controls, and the event-study version is DVR##ib2010.year. One policy date, so the two-adoption-dates rule fails. No analysis data are shipped (Thomson Refinitiv/Datastream subscription data plus hand-coded by-laws).
design_notes: 'Code used to generate outputs.do': outcomes pct_for_owni (foreign institutional ownership), pct_frenchi, pct_insider_fam, long/short-term institutional ownership splits, capex_ta, tobins_Q, ROA, ESG pillar scores; sample dvd_prior==0 (firms without DVR before Florange); DVR vs DVR_ext definitions; psacalc Oster bounds; portfolio return analysis in a separate sample. 'Sample and variable creation.do' builds the panel from nine Refinitiv extracts that are not included.
data_provenance: not shipped (Thomson Refinitiv EIKON/Datastream; manual by-law coding reported in the online appendix)
screener_notes: Flags 'staggered' refer to staggered boards (a control variable), not staggered adoption. Screened from package only.
